import ctypes
import numpy as np
import os

def assert_test():
    try:
        # Load libraries in the correct order
        ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
        gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

        # Define function prototypes
        gsl.gsl_wavelet_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)
        gsl.gsl_wavelet_workspace_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)
        gsl.gsl_wavelet_transform_forward.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
        gsl.gsl_wavelet_transform_inverse.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
        gsl.gsl_sort.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
        gsl.gsl_wavelet_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
        gsl.gsl_wavelet_workspace_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]

        # Prepare input data
        input_file = "test_data.txt"
        n = 256
        nc = 20

        # Generate test data file
        np.random.seed(42)
        test_data = np.random.rand(n)
        np.savetxt(input_file, test_data)

        # Allocate memory
        orig_data = (ctypes.c_double * n)()
        data = (ctypes.c_double * n)()
        abscoeff = (ctypes.c_double * n)()

        # Read data from file
        with open(input_file, "r") as f:
            for i, line in enumerate(f):
                orig_data[i] = float(line.strip())
                data[i] = orig_data[i]

        # Allocate wavelet and workspace
        wavelet_type = ctypes.c_void_p.in_dll(gsl, "gsl_wavelet_daubechies")
        w = gsl.gsl_wavelet_alloc(wavelet_type, 4)
        if not w:
            raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate wavelet.")

        work = gsl.gsl_wavelet_workspace_alloc(n)
        if not work:
            gsl.gsl_wavelet_free(w)
            raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate wavelet workspace.")

        # Perform forward wavelet transform
        ret = gsl.gsl_wavelet_transform_forward(w, data, 1, n, work)
        if ret != 0:
            gsl.gsl_wavelet_free(w)
            gsl.gsl_wavelet_workspace_free(work)
            raise RuntimeError(f"Forward wavelet transform failed with error code {ret}.")

        # Compute absolute coefficients
        for i in range(n):
            abscoeff[i] = abs(data[i])

        # Sort absolute coefficients
        sorted_indices = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: abscoeff[i])

        # Zero out smallest coefficients
        for i in range(nc):
            data[sorted_indices[i]] = 0

        # Perform inverse wavelet transform
        ret = gsl.gsl_wavelet_transform_inverse(w, data, 1, n, work)
        if ret != 0:
            gsl.gsl_wavelet_free(w)
            gsl.gsl_wavelet_workspace_free(work)
            raise RuntimeError(f"Inverse wavelet transform failed with error code {ret}.")

        # Print original and transformed data
        for i in range(n):
            print(f"{orig_data[i]} {data[i]}")

        # Free memory
        gsl.gsl_wavelet_free(w)
        gsl.gsl_wavelet_workspace_free(work)

        # Clean up test file
        os.remove(input_file)

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
        raise

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
